newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate rises at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate rises at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate rose slightly at mid-session on Thursday after the central bank announced it would issue T$5 billion negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day to mop up excess funds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.370 percent against Wednesday's 6.338 close -- far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.30 percent against 6.35.
Dealers said they expected the rates to hover at the current levels for the rest of the session.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0888 percent against 6.0890-0895.
